name: Setup Wizard helicopter rules match the Configurator's
step: Check the Setup Wizard's swash, servo and pitch math
rationale:
Wizards -> Model setup is the radio's copy of rotorflight-configurator's helicopter
Setup Wizard, and every step leans on lib/setup_wizard_heli.lua for the same rules:
which servos each swash type drives, the mixer and servo override units (1000 = 12 degrees
main, 24 degrees tail, 50 degrees servo arm), the pitch calibration that rescales a mixer
rate from a measured blade angle, the servo type bands, and the receiver channel
detection and throttle range.

The harness pins each against the value the Configurator's heli.js gives for the same
input. --self-test re-runs it against a copy whose pitch calibration ignores the
measurement, and requires that to fail.
